title: Hotel comparison
titleCn: 美国酒店对比推荐（雅思听力Part2）

paragraphs.text: Part two.
You will hear a radio travel program in which a presenter is talking about various hotels.
First, you have some time to look at questions eleven to sixteen.
Now listen carefully and answer questions eleven to sixteen.

Good morning, everyone. Today, I'm looking at hotels in the USA. Six months ago, I asked listeners who had visited the USA to send me their comments on any hotels they'd stayed at. I got hundreds of replies, and I'm going to give you some of the results today. Overall, most visitors were very happy with their choice of hotel.

Let's start with one in California that our listeners visited, the Laguna Park. Not a bad option, and this hotel scored highly as being very reasonably priced. Everyone was very satisfied with the family-friendly environment, and many people mentioned the large rooms with their views of the Pacific Ocean.
Moving on now to Mirror Lake, also in California.
This hotel scored highest of all the hotels with especially high marks for employee attitude.

One listener mentioned the fact that they were particularly good at organizing activities to keep everyone happy all the time. As he has four children, he was very pleased about that as you can imagine.

The Creekside in Oregon got some very good reviews from people who went there on honeymoon. They enjoyed the tranquility. Only couples are allowed and the beautiful gardens. The bedrooms are spacious, and there's a choice of swimming pools.
Now to Colorado and the Canyon Hotel.
Just the place for an excellent night's sleep by all accounts, a very good mattress, and lovely white cotton sheets. There's also a huge swimming pool.

A bit expensive according to some listeners as food isn't included in the price. Now The Woodlands is in New England. Plenty to do at this resort for all the family. It's one place you can work out as there's an excellent gym available with all the latest machines from weights to running machines. However, our listeners commented that more staff are needed on hand to supervise.
Sunset Heights is on the coast in South Carolina and is just the place for a family holiday. As the beach is nearby, it doesn't really matter that there isn't a pool.
One listener thought that the fitness suite needed updating, but apart from that, most people enjoyed their stay here as it's so near the local tourist attractions.
Before you hear the rest of the talk, you have some time to look at questions seventeen to twenty.
Now listen and answer questions seventeen to twenty.
Now, I want to look in more detail at Mirror Lake Hotel as it did so well in the survey. If you go on their website, you'll be able to get an up-to-date idea of what the hotel offers.
Unlike other hotels in the area, there are no conference facilities. Everything is geared to the tourist rather than the businessman.
One attraction is a brand new spa with a range of very relaxing beauty treatments.
But you will need to go into town to get your hair done. You can get online from every room, which is a real plus, and they're thinking of bringing in a free DVD service in the near future.
Now, everyone's keen on special offers, aren't they? And Mirror Lake has a few this summer.
First of all, even though there's never any charge for children under fifteen if they stay in their parents' room, the hotel will be giving away food for the kids as well.
The first lucky ten families who book a holiday this summer will also get a larger room with a balcony all for the standard room price,
so that as well as the usual generous welcome pack, you'll have twice the space you were expecting.
The hotel also has a great deal with a local car hire company, and prices have been reduced by up to twenty percent.
So get booking that holiday and have a really brilliant summer.
That is the end of part two. You now have thirty seconds to check your answers to part two.
